title: Y B Normal SportFishing
specs: Boat is a 43-foot Torres sportfishing boat with air-conditioned interior, bathroom, and galley
Fishing techniques include light tackle, heavy tackle, bottom fishing, trolling, spinning, jigging, drift fishing, kite fishing, deep sea fishing
Target species include amberjack, barracuda, bonito, dolphin (mahi mahi), grouper, king mackerel, shark, snapper, tilefish
blurb: Guests fish for various species including shark, mahi-mahi, tuna, and wahoo using multiple techniques such as trolling, jigging, and kite fishing. The boat is equipped with modern electronics and amenities including air conditioning, bathroom, and galley. Charters depart from Port Everglades and serve Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood, and Dania Beach.
extraNote: Docked at north Port Everglades Inlet, Dania Beach, Florida

quotes.author: Justin Blake
quotes.text: What an incredible day on the water! The boat was spotless, well-maintained, and having air conditioning inside made a huge difference, especially for the kids. The crew was friendly, patient, and great with our family, making sure everyone had a great time from start to finish. The fishing was absolutely phenomenal. We caught over 30 mahi-mahi throughout the day, with 16 legal fish coming home with us. The action was nonstop, and the captain clearly knew exactly where to find the fish. If you’re looking for a family-friendly charter with a clean, comfortable boat and a crew that puts you on fish, this is the one. We made amazing memories and can’t wait to book again!

quotes.author: Greg Smith
quotes.text: Let me start off by saying I booked 10 hr fishing trip on Wednesday may 26th 2026. 1 hr into the trip a passenger on the boat got extremely sick 😫. By 10 am we had landed 12 fish in the box, I asked the captain (Vinnie) to turn the boat around and take us back to shore!!! He did and we got our passenger on land. The Captain ( Vinnie) told me to come back the next day and complete my 10 trip and fish the remaining hrs I was unable to fish. Let me say he went way out of his way to accommodate me For my fishing trip which was outstanding

quotes.author: Fabrizio Vedda
quotes.text: First time fishing on a boat, phenomenal time with a great crew! Snagged a marlin!!! Plenty of tuna to go around! I highly recommend anyone that’s looking for a fishing charter, this is the one! Definitely booking again. Thank you guys a ton had a great time!

quotes.author: mason mcneill
quotes.text: Captain vinnie and mate John are true professionals and masters of their craft! Very good communication throughout the whole process and we were able to catch a ton of fish in the time allotted. The boat was clean and comfortable, would absolutely recommend

quotes.author: Fabia Calderon
quotes.text: We had an amazing experience with my family aboard the YB Normal with Captain Vinnie and John. These guys know what they’re doing and are nice to be around. I absolutely recommend them! We’ll be back!

quotes.author: Brandy Suarez
quotes.text: Captain Vinny and Captain John were amazing. Couldn’t recommend it more! They took photos, some videos, they knew where to fish and made you feel comfortable doing it even as beginners.
